title: should not render the Play Session Replay button for a regular trace without a RUM session
verifies: a trace with no RUM bridge span never renders the gated Play Session Replay button

title: should show the Play Session Replay button for a replayable RUM session and navigate to its Session Viewer
verifies: a dangling-parent trace matched by a session_has_replay:true _rumdata row shows the Play button and clicking it lands on the correct Session Viewer URL

title: should hide the Play Session Replay button when the RUM session has no recording
verifies: a trace with a non-replayable RUM bridge span (no session_has_replay) keeps the Play button hidden

title: should show the no-replay empty state for a session with no recording
verifies: the Session Viewer renders the No-replay-was-recorded empty state naming the session id while retaining back navigation
